died.name: Ælfheah of Canterbury
died.cause: refusing to pay ransom before being killed by his Danish captors
died.last_words: You urge me in vain. I am not the man to provide Christian flesh for pagan teeth to devour, and it would be so acting if I delivered unto you that which the poor have laid by for their subsistence.

died.name: Philip Melanchthon
died.cause: when asked if he wanted anything

died.name: Benjamin Rush
died.desc: American physician, signer of the United States Declaration of Independence
died.last_words: I will not abandon the post which Providence has assigned me; I think it my duty not only to sacrifice my pleasure and repose, but my life, should it be necessary, for the safety of my patients.

died.name: Benjamin Disraeli
died.desc: Prime Minister of the United Kingdom
died.cause: declining a visit from Queen Victoria
died.last_words: No, it is better not. She will only ask me to take a message to Albert.

died.name: Charles Darwin
died.last_words: I am not in the least afraid to die.

born.name: Zygmunt Pawlaczyk
born.desc: the captain of LOT Polish Airlines Flight 5055
born.cause: to air traffic control as the plane crashed into the ground

born.name: Karel Soucek
born.cause: prior to fatal barrel drop from ceiling of Houston Astrodome
born.last_words: I'm ready. It feels good. It's a go.
